jobs.description:
As a warehouse worker in Wevelgem, you will be involved in the entire logistics process, from receiving to shipping goods. Every day, you use an electric pallet truck, forklift, and handheld scanner. You make sure everything is stored properly, orders are ready on time, and the warehouse stays tidy.
Your day starts between 7 and 8 AM, depending on your training. You pick orders, load and unload trucks and containers, and handle the administrative tasks related to shipments. For this, you use a PC, printer, and ERP system. You carry out simple visual checks and make sure everything runs safely and according to company guidelines. You actively participate in the daily team meeting with your colleagues and support each other.
Ready to roll up your sleeves and feel at home in a warehouse? Apply quickly and make a difference in a growing company!

You speak and write fluent Dutch (preferably), and/or English and/or French.You have a certificate for electric pallet truck and forklift.Experience in a warehouse environment is a plus.You work accurately and with a focus on quality.You are flexible and have a hands-on attitude.You enjoy working in a team and communicate respectfully.You actively participate in the daily team meeting.

Do you have experience in micro welding? Are you open for a production job? Does the world of railway and airspace interests you? Then this is a job for you. Our client, a great player in the world of logistics, is looking for a handy production employee. They are looking in the department that makes the black boxes is looking for a new colleague. 

The job

• operating the pick and place machine
• micro welding of different electronic components
• assembling and wiring of electronic components 
• quality check of the production proces 

• very good knowledge of French and English
• experience in micro welding

jobs.occupation: Inside sales | German market | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
As an Inside Sales Representative, you will take ownership of the German market, developing new business opportunities and building long-term customer relationships. You will join a dynamic, international family-owned company in the food industry, where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a well-established international company operating within the food sector. With a family-business mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and strong growth ambitions, they offer a fast-paced environment where initiative and results are highly valued.

Omschrijving

•  Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities within the German market.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing deals.
• Conduct commercial negotiations and follow up on sales opportunities.
• Expand the customer portfolio and strengthen market presence.
• Analyze sales performance and market trends.
• Report on sales activities and contribute to the overall sales strategy.
 

•  Fluent in German and English, knowledge of Dutch or additional languages is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development, or a commercial role.
• Strong commercial acumen and a results-oriented mindset.
• A true go-getter with the drive to open new doors and create opportunities.
• Confident communicator with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Affinity with the food industry is an advantage.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.

Conforma is a Contract Manufacturing Organisation (CMO) specialising in the manufacturing of non-sterile liquid and semi-solid pharmaceutical and medical device products, including solutions, syrups, gels and creams.
 

As we expand internationally, we are looking for an Outbound Sales professional to identify new opportunities, build a qualified prospect pipeline and support our commercial visibility.
 

This is a 
 hands-on commercial role 
combining market research, lead generation, outbound sales and business development. You will identify companies whose products could potentially be manufactured by Conforma, assess whether they have internal manufacturing capabilities, and identify the right people to approach.
 

You will help us turn market intelligence into concrete commercial opportunities.
 

Your responsibilities
 

· Identify and map potential customers across Europe and, subsequently, international markets
 

· Research companies, product portfolios and manufacturing capabilities to identify potential outsourcing and contract manufacturing opportunities
 

· Build and maintain a structured, high-quality prospect database and prioritise opportunities based on commercial potential
 

· Identify relevant decision-makers and map professional contact details
 

· Use online research, professional networks, databases and direct telephone contact to obtain or verify information and establish the right point of contact
 

· Support targeted outbound campaigns and follow up qualified leads together with the Business Development team
 

· Support the organisation and commercial follow-up of relevant international trade fairs and industry events
 

· Help keep Conforma's LinkedIn company page professional, current and engaging by contributing to relevant posts and content

We are looking for someone who is curious, commercially minded, proactive and not afraid to pick up the phone. You enjoy investigating companies, finding information that is not immediately available and turning that information into actionable opportunities.
 

· A higher education degree or equivalent experience in business, marketing, life sciences, pharmaceutical sciences, international business or a related field
 

· Excellent written and spoken Dutch & English is essential
 

· Strong research, analytical and organisational skills
 

· Excellent communication skills and the confidence to speak with people you have never contacted before
 

· A commercial mindset and genuine interest in business development
 

· Persistence and the ability to professionally obtain information
 

· Good digital and online research skills
 

· The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the Business Development team
 

What makes this role different?
 

This is not a traditional telesales position. You will not simply work through a predefined list of leads. You will help build our international market map from the ground up: identifying potential customers, understanding their products and manufacturing footprint, discovering where outsourcing opportunities may exist and determining who we should speak to.
 

Your work will directly contribute to Conforma's international growth and give you the opportunity to build a broad network within the pharmaceutical and medical device industries.

As a cleanroom assistant you play a crucial role in the production process of advanced cell therapies. After extensive training in aseptic and GMP-compliant work, you and your colleagues will contribute to daily production activities following strict standard procedures.

As a cleanroom assistant you will be the person who ensures that day-to-day operations run smoothly and trouble-free within the cleanroom environment

• Supporting the aseptic and manual production process.

• Checking, maintaining, and cleaning equipment and materials.

• Ensuring proper transfer between different production zones.

• Adhering to established quality and safety standards to guarantee timely therapies for patients.

• A strong sense of responsibility and passion for healthcare.

• Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

• Accuracy and willingness to work in an aseptic environment with sterile clothing.

• An A2 diploma or equivalent experience – full training is provided.

• Willingness to work in several shifts (early,late, nights) and on weekends.

• You have your own transport, depending on the distance this can be with a car, electric bike,.. (because of the shifts you can not rely on public transport)

• Good knowledge of English.

You work on a production line in the cold, warm or expedition department. You fill, garnish or label products and ensure everything runs smoothly with your colleagues. You follow strict hygiene and quality rules. You contribute to a safe and organized workplace.

• Good Dutch or fluent English

• Fast and accurate working style (line work)

• Strong focus on quality and hygiene

• Neat appearance (no gel nails, visible piercings, etc.)

• Comfortable working in cold (0–4°C)

• Team player

• Experience in production is a plus

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!
 

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 
 

 
 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.
 

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.
 

What You’ll Do
 

 
• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
 
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
 
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
 
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
 
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients. 
 

Good to Know You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends, but no night shifts. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:
 

 
• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
 
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
 
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
 
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.
 
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

Finance Administration:

• Assist in recruitment, onboarding, offboarding and training of new employees and trainees.

• Participate in improving office environment (plants, work-friendly spaces, etc) 
• Ensure the office is clean, and the employees respect the office rules (kitchen, sanitary) 
• Schedule and organising documents for staff weekly, monthly, and quarterly meetings 
• Being the person of contact for the IT Consultant 
• Liaise with staff members regarding hardware (problems encountered, requests for equipment, etc.,) 
• Monitor IT equipment (list of equipment, storage, depreciation list) 
• Prepare workstations for new staff 
• Follow up with the phone system (user access and account) ¿ Support staff members with workstation equipment.

• Make travel arrangements including flights, accommodation, and ground transportation 
The Assistant will organize and support the office's day-to-day finance and employee's administration. The Assistant plays a crucial role in ensuring that office operations run smoothly and accurately and that our records are maintained in compliance with internal procedures.

Education & Qualifications 

• Bachelor's degree in administration, accounting, HR related fields (or equivalent) 
Experience - Essential

• Effective communication skills in English including verbal and written skills 
• Understanding of office routine

Experience - Desirable

Skills & Attributes 

• Excellent time management and organizational skills 
• Excellent administration skills 
• High attention to detail 
• Strong problem solving and communication skills 
• Only EU citizens or non-EU nationals with a valid Belgian working permit can apply

• Based at the IFOAM Organics Europe office in Brussels

• Employment period: determined contract of 8 months with a tentative starting date as November 1 st , renewable 
• High level of flexibility with floating hours and possibility of home working

Over the last few years, the company has made a strategic shift towards one of the fastest-growing markets: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning and AI Leadership.

Today, their challenge isn't finding talent.

It's finding enough clients for the exceptional consultants already in the business.

That's where you come in.

Description

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and growing a portfolio of clients across Brussels and Belgium.

From first contact to long-term partnership, you'll own the entire sales cycle.

You will:

• Identify and approach new clients
• Build relationships with decision-makers and executives
• Understand business challenges and propose the right consulting solution
• Sell AI expertise
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals

• Continuously expand your network and market knowledge
 

• You know how staffing and consulting work.

As a Bus Diagnostic Technician, you’ll help lead the transition to smart, electric passenger transport. You’ll work in a modern workshop where you track down, analyze, and solve technical faults on buses from various brands. From day one, you play a crucial role in getting our vehicles back on the road quickly and safely.

On a typical workday, you analyze malfunctions using diagnostic equipment, read error codes, and interpret electrical diagrams. You carry out mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs and maintain precise work administration. You support colleagues with complex problems, assist with roadside service during working hours, and continue to learn about new technologies such as electric drive systems.

Are you ready to further develop your technical expertise in a rapidly evolving sector? Apply today and discover a varied job where quality, teamwork, and innovation are key!

• Degree in automotive engineering, electromechanics, or equivalent through experience

• At least 2 years of experience as a diagnostic, bus, or truck technician

• Strong knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and electronics

• Experience with diagnostic equipment

• Valid driver's license B (D is a plus)

• Good command of Dutch or English

• Accurate, quality-oriented, and a real team player

• Experience with electric vehicles or an HEV2 certificate is a plus, but not required

• Technical mindset and eagerness to learn are essential

• Willingness for occasional roadside service during or outside working hours

• Service vehicle for business and private use (after 6 months)
